pharmacology.text: Clonidine produces most of its pharmacodynamic effects by acting as a non-selective partial agonist at α2 adrenoceptors (α2A, α2B, and α2C), where it can mimic the actions of endogenous norepinephrine at these receptors in the central nervous system and the sympathetic nervous system. Clonidine can also bind imidazoline I1 receptors in brainstem regions involved in cardiovascular responses.
pharmacology.kind: α2-Adrenergic receptor agonist; Imidazoline receptor agonists; Anxiolytic; Sedative

body.says: IR: 12–16 hours; 41 hours in kidney failure, 48 hours for repeated dosing

uses.text: Clonidine is used to treat high blood pressure, attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), withdrawal from drugs including (but not necessarily limited to) alcohol, opioids, and nicotine, as well as menopausal flushing, diarrhea, and certain pain conditions.

sideEffects.text: Common side effects include dry mouth, dizziness, headaches, hypotension, and sleepiness. Severe side effects may include hallucinations, heart arrhythmias, and confusion.

summaryZh: 可樂定（英語：Clonidine），是一種用來治療高血壓、注意力缺陷多動障礙、焦慮症、抽動綜合症、偏頭痛、「酒精、鴉片、尼古丁的戒斷症狀」、更年期潮熱、腹瀉和特定類型疼痛的藥物。可樂定歸類為α2腎上腺受體活化劑和imidazoline受體活化劑，被應用於臨床已有超過40年的歷史。
